name: day19-transformer-rag-eval
description: Hand-written cases tied to stable sample chunk IDs.

cases.question: How does self-attention help a Transformer capture long-range relationships?
cases.reference_answer: Self-attention creates direct paths between tokens, helping the model capture long-range dependencies.

cases.question: What roles do queries, keys, and values play in self-attention?
cases.reference_answer: Queries represent what a token is looking for, keys describe what each token offers, and values carry the information that attention combines.

cases.question: Why should a long document be split into chunks before embedding and retrieval?
cases.reference_answer: A single vector for a long document can hide a small relevant section, while chunking creates focused retrieval units.

cases.question: Why is overlap useful between adjacent document chunks?
cases.reference_answer: Overlap copies some text into the next chunk so an idea crossing a boundary keeps surrounding context.

cases.question: What metadata should a chunk keep so a RAG system can trace and cite its source?
cases.reference_answer: Each chunk should retain its source document, page range, section name, and stable chunk identifier for filtering, debugging, and citations.
